# script code

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:scriptCode`](gmeow-scriptCode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/scriptCode>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The ISO 15924 script code of a writing system ("Latn", "Hani", "Hira", "Kana", "Arab", "Brai") when one exists, else a bespoke identifier for a conlang/AI script with no registered code. The bridge for names' [`gmeow:nameScript`](gmeow-nameScript.md) literals to resolve to a first-class [`WritingSystem`](../classes/gmeow-WritingSystem.md). Non-functional.
